title: Re-boundary Plan 2020-2021: Statistical Administrative Boundary Revision
relevant_claims: Tonga Statistics Department framework identifies country/division/district/village/census-block levels and five divisions including Vava'u.
TSD mapwork changed census blocks and added census units for fieldwork; it states village-to-division boundaries would not be changed because they are reported and legally constrained.
This is statistical framework context and does not provide the original 2017 geoBoundaries Vava'u ADM1 polygon or direct candidate-point resolution.
use_limit: Primary statistical source-role/date context; not a cadastral or legal ADM1 geometry.

title: Tonga 2021 Population and Housing Census — Census Pre-activities
relevant_claims: The department revised census-block boundaries through TSGF to improve data collection/geographic accuracy.
Objectives were manageable block sizes, comparability with old/new administrative boundaries, and semi-village settlement representation.
use_limit: Census block framework; no division boundary geometry in inspected page.

title: Electoral Boundaries Regulations, Cap. 2.04.01 (2020 Revised Edition; regulations dated 2017)
relevant_claims: Schedules 16-18 describe Vava'u 14-16 as electoral constituencies using estate boundaries, roads and Mean High Water Mark; they are not the whole Vava'u ADM1 island-division polygon.
use_limit: Authoritative legal electoral-boundary evidence for a distinct geographic purpose; must not be substituted for Vava'u ADM1.
